turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm baking something for my friend's birthday, and I can't decide what.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me walk you through all the options, then you can tell me what you think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first idea is a classic chocolate layer cake with fudge frosting, which takes most of a day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a lemon drizzle loaf, which is simple and I've made it before.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is a big batch of decorated cupcakes so everyone gets their own.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is a fruit tart with a homemade crust, which looks really fancy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it. Now you can comment.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The chocolate layer cake is the most classic birthday choice, if you have the time. Cupcakes are easier to share at a party and fun to decorate. The lemon loaf is the safe bet since you've already nailed it.
